summary: Under Decree 93, a special census in Hesekê province stripped about 120,000 Kurds (20% of Kurds within Syrian state borders at the time) of citizenship, leaving them stateless and unable to own land, property or businesses. Human Rights Watch describes it as part of a plan to Arabise the resource-rich northeast.
